meta.title: Japan Grid & Data-Center Power Suppliers
meta.subtitle: Vetted Japanese manufacturers to import, represent, or broker in the US
meta.note: All contact details must be confirmed via each company's official website before any outreach.

suppliers.name: Hitachi Energy Japan Ltd.
suppliers.nameJp: 日立エナジー株式会社
suppliers.products: Power transformers, SF6-free gas-insulated switchgear (EconiQ line, including world-first 550 kV SF6-free GIS), HVDC systems, grid automation and SCADA, FACTS, protection relays, grid-scale battery energy storage (e-mesh PowerStore).
suppliers.exportNote: Active US operations and sales channels; Japan subsidiary angle valuable for T&D equipment sourcing, grid-modernization engineering, and IRA-funded utility projects.
suppliers.relevance: Global T&D technology leader with deep Japan engineering roots; received Chubu Electric Power Grid order for world-first 550 kV SF6-free GIS; HVDC, transformer, and grid-automation lines are high-demand in US grid buildout; 24/7 Customer Connect Center facilitates partner onboarding.

suppliers.name: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation
suppliers.products: Power and distribution transformers (Top Runner energy-saving series), generator step-up and autotransformers, gas-insulated transformers, gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), HVDC systems, protection and supervisory relay systems, smart-grid energy-management solutions.
suppliers.exportNote: Investing $86 M in a new Pennsylvania switchgear and power-electronics plant — signals strong US market push and creates natural conversation for transformer and relay distribution partnerships.
suppliers.relevance: One of the world's largest transformer and switchgear OEMs (over 4.4 trillion yen revenue); US manufacturing expansion underway; Top Runner energy-efficient transformers are directly importable; room for additional US channel partners on specific product lines.

suppliers.name: Fuji Electric Co., Ltd.
suppliers.products: Large-capacity UPS systems (7000HX series, 97% device-conversion efficiency using in-house SiC power semiconductors), data-center switchgear, power conditioners, medium-voltage inverters and drives, renewable-energy power electronics.
suppliers.exportNote: Fuji Electric Corp. of America (FECOA) established 1970 and active in the US — proven import and after-sales channel for UPS and power semiconductor product lines.
suppliers.relevance: Proprietary in-house SiC semiconductor development delivers industry-leading 97% conversion efficiency in UPS; the 7000HX UPS is deployed in Japanese and global data centers; FECOA has been operating in the US for over 50 years — the import infrastructure exists and can be extended to additional product lines.

suppliers.name: TMEIC Corporation
suppliers.products: Industrial and critical-infrastructure UPS, utility-scale solar and wind inverters, large-capacity variable-frequency drives, motor control systems for steel, paper, and petrochemical plants, industrial automation systems.
suppliers.exportNote: TMEIC already operates a US subsidiary in Roanoke, VA; the Japan parent is the design and manufacturing hub — ideal for product-line representation or OEM sourcing agreements targeting US industrial and utility markets.
suppliers.relevance: Toshiba-Mitsubishi Electric joint venture combining both OEMs' power electronics heritage; industrial UPS and utility-scale solar inverter lines directly addressable for US distribution or OEM partnerships; active US footprint reduces market-entry friction compared with less-established exporters.

suppliers.name: Meidensha Corporation
suppliers.products: Power transmission and distribution systems, vacuum circuit breakers, protection and supervisory relays, substation automation, energy storage systems, surge arresters (zinc-oxide), rail electrification systems, inverters and dynamometers.
suppliers.exportNote: North American operational presence confirmed; 27,000-plus patents; protection relay and substation automation lines have fewer dedicated US distributors than the mega-OEMs — clear brokering angle for grid-modernization projects.
suppliers.relevance: Nikkei 225-listed T&D specialist with over 120 years of operating history; vacuum circuit breakers and protection relays are in high US demand driven by grid-modernization and renewable-integration spending; approximately 1.9 billion USD revenue with North American offices providing a warm entry point for US-based reps.

suppliers.name: Nissin Electric Co., Ltd.
suppliers.products: Gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), power capacitors, power transformers, shunt reactors, instrument transformers (CT/VT), medium- and low-voltage metal-enclosed switchgear, reactive power compensation equipment (SVC/SVG), islanding protection devices, PV interconnection systems.
suppliers.exportNote: Sumitomo Group affiliate with subsidiaries in the US, China, Taiwan, Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, India, and Spain — proven multi-country export infrastructure; reactive power compensation products are rapidly growing in US demand.
suppliers.relevance: Kyoto-based specialist in GIS, reactive power compensation, and PV interconnection; US subsidiary exists but specific product-line representation such as SVG, GIS, and instrument transformers may still be open for brokering; Sumitomo group backing ensures financial stability and long-term supply commitment.

suppliers.name: DAIHEN Corporation
suppliers.products: Oil-immersed and cast-resin distribution transformers (Top Runner standard), pole-mounted utility transformers for all major Japanese electric utilities, shunt reactors, closed-type power distribution boards with remote monitoring, solar inverters (grid-tie), wireless power transfer systems.
suppliers.exportNote: Founded 1919 as Osaka Transformer Co.; supplies all major Japanese electric utilities; cast-resin and oil-immersed lines directly importable for US data centers, hospitals, commercial buildings, and renewable-energy sites.
suppliers.relevance: Over 100 years of utility-grade transformer expertise; cast-resin transformer range well-suited to US data center and commercial building applications (fire-resistant, indoor-safe); limited dedicated US distribution channel creates a clear import and representation opportunity.

suppliers.name: Takaoka Toko Co., Ltd.
suppliers.products: Distribution transformers, molded current transformers (CT), voltage transformers (VT) and combined VCT units, zero-phase-sequence CTs, watt-hour meters, power monitoring systems, power distribution network equipment, renewable energy grid-integration systems.
suppliers.exportNote: Medium-Term Management Plan 2027 targets international expansion; instrument transformers and smart-metering equipment are directly importable for US utility AMI and smart-grid upgrade programs.
suppliers.relevance: Specialist in distribution infrastructure and precision instrument transformers for electric utilities; executing a SERA company energy-network modernization strategy signaling active product pipeline development; limited US import and rep presence makes this a prime niche target for a US-based broker or distributor.

suppliers.name: NGK Corporation
suppliers.products: NAS (sodium-sulfur) grid-scale battery energy storage systems; UHV-class (up to 1 MV) suspension, hollow, station-post, and pin-post insulators; transformer bushings; hollow insulators for high-voltage switchgear.
suppliers.exportNote: Serves North America, Europe, and Asia; NAS batteries are already deployed in US and international grid-storage projects; insulators supply US and global transmission infrastructure upgrades.
suppliers.relevance: World-leading NAS battery technology directly relevant to surging US energy-storage procurement driven by IRA incentives; dominant global supplier of UHV-class insulators needed for US high-voltage transmission expansion; strong import and distribution business case for both product lines across utility and grid-storage segments.

sources.name: NGK
sources.title: Insulators and Power Equipment — NGK Corporation

suppliers.name: Sanyo Denki Co., Ltd.
suppliers.products: SANUPS-brand online double-conversion UPS, hybrid smart UPS, parallel and redundant N+1 configurable UPS (1 kVA and up), PV power conditioners, engine generators; also servo systems and high-reliability cooling systems for data center thermal management.
suppliers.exportNote: Already operates a dedicated US web portal (sanups.sanyodenki.us) for single-phase UPS (1-20 kVA); explicitly offers customized and private-label solutions for US channel partners.
suppliers.relevance: Founded 1927; explicitly markets OEM and private-label arrangements to US distribution partners; Japan-designed UPS systems accepted in US semiconductor, medical, traffic-control, and telecom verticals; among the clearest niche entry points for a US importer or manufacturers rep seeking Japanese UPS lines.

suppliers.name: Terasaki Electric Co., Ltd.
suppliers.nameJp: 寺崎電気産業株式会社
suppliers.products: Air circuit breakers (ACBs), molded-case circuit breakers (MCCBs), electronic trip units, power distribution switchboards, marine and industrial switchgear, generator-protection breakers (TemBreak PRO series), selectivity analysis software (TemCurve Lite).
suppliers.exportNote: Already exports to Europe, Middle East, and Africa via Terasaki Electric Europe Ltd.; US is a logical next market for IEC-rated circuit breakers and marine switchgear given existing export infrastructure.
suppliers.relevance: First Japanese company to develop circuit breakers entirely in-house; proven European export channel demonstrates export maturity and willingness; IEC 60947-compliant ACBs and MCCBs suitable for US import into industrial, marine, commercial building, and data center applications — limited current US distribution presence.

suppliers.name: Shizuki Electric Co., Inc.
suppliers.products: Film capacitors for power electronics and grid inverters (oil-filled and dry-type), power factor correction capacitor banks, harmonic filter capacitors, series reactors, custom-engineered capacitor solutions for industrial inverter and UPS OEMs.
suppliers.exportNote: US affiliate ASC Capacitors (Ogallala, Nebraska) already imports and sells Shizuki products in North America — proven US supply chain and strong existing precedent for expanded brokering.
suppliers.relevance: Niche leader in power film capacitors essential for grid inverters, UPS, and power factor correction systems; US affiliate ASC Capacitors already imports Shizuki products — excellent platform for expanding US distribution of capacitor banks, harmonic filter systems, and custom power electronics components to OEMs and utilities.

suppliers.name: Kawamura Electric Inc.
suppliers.products: Distribution panelboards, residential and industrial load centers, low- and high-voltage circuit breakers, industrial and building control panels, high-voltage switchgear (JEM-standard), EV charging control panels.
suppliers.exportNote: JEMA member with over 3,600 patents and global offices; LV/MV distribution boards and HV switchgear are importable product lines with broad US commercial, industrial, and EV-charging demand.
suppliers.relevance: Founded 1919; over 3,600 patents in circuit breakers and high-voltage equipment; approximately 1,000 employees with global presence; focused on LV/MV distribution switchgear and panelboards — limited US representation is a clear distribution opportunity, especially for commercial building, industrial, and EV-charging infrastructure applications.

suppliers.name: Togami Electric Mfg. Co., Ltd.
suppliers.products: Magnetic contactors (IEC 60947-compliant, TUV/CE/CCC/NK certified), magnetic starters, thermal overload relays, PCB relays for inrush-current and pre-charge circuits, high-voltage distribution boards, explosion-proof and corrosion-resistant control equipment.
suppliers.exportNote: Products carry IEC 60947, TUV, NK, CE, and CCC certifications; ISO 9001/14001 certified manufacturing — compliant with both US industrial and international standards for direct import.
suppliers.relevance: Established 1925; IEC- and TUV-certified contactors and starters are high-volume industrial motor-control components with broad US demand across panel builders, OEMs, and industrial end-users; no dedicated US rep or import channel readily identified — prime brokering opportunity.
